mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT B.ACCT_NO as acctNo, C.ACCT_NAME as acctName FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO B, STL_CAPACCT_INFO C WHERE B.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND B.ACCT_TYPE = #{capacctType} AND B.CCY = #{ccy} AND B.ACCT_NO = C.ACCT_NO AND B.CCY = C.CCY

SELECT DISTINCT B.ACCT_NO as acctNo, C.ACCT_NAME as acctName FROM STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT B, STL_CAPACCT_INFO C WHERE B.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} and b.ACCT_TYPE=#{capacctType} AND B.CCY = #{ccy} AND B.ACCT_NO = C.ACCT_NO AND B.CCY = C.CCY
SELECT DISTINCT B.ACCT_NO as acctNo, C.ACCT_NAME as acctName FROM stl_fin_product_acct B, STL_CAPACCT_INFO C WHERE b.ACCT_NO = c.ACCT_NO and B.FINPROD_ID = #{chlId}
SELECT DISTINCT B.ACCT_NO as acctNo, B.ACCT_NAME as acctName FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO A, STL_CAPACCT_INFO B WHERE A.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secManageAcctId} AND A.TRD_ACCT_ID = B.ACCT_NO AND B.CCY = #{ccy}

SELECT DISTINCT C.ACCT_NO as acctNo, C.ACCT_NAME as acctName FROM FIN_CASH_INFO A, MST_COUNTER_ACCT B, STL_CAPACCT_INFO C WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND A.CHL_FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL AND A.CHL_LEVEL = 1 AND B.COUNTER_ID = A.CHL_FINPROD_ID AND B.ACCT_TYPE = #{acctType} AND B.ACCT_NO = C.ACCT_NO AND B.CCY = C.CCY
SELECT PROFIT_TYPE as profitType FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
SELECT A.IS_GUARANTEE isGuarantee FROM PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO A WHERE A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
SELECT CASE WHEN PORTFOLIO_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID=#{counterId}
SELECT ASSET_PROVIDER as assetProvider FROM PA_FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT DISTINCT case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SPO.MY_ACCT_NO else SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO end payAcctNo, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO else SPO.MY_ACCT_NO end recAcctNo, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SCI.ACCT_NAME else SCI1.ACCT_NAME end payAcctName, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SCI1.ACCT_NAME else SCI.ACCT_NAME end recAcctName, SPO.PS, SPO.IS_NEED_SEND, SPO.PAY_TYPE, SPO.SETTLE_DATE, SPO.SETTLE_AMT, SPO.CCY, SPO.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, SPO.SETTLE_STATUS, SPO.PURPOSE, SPO.TRADE_ID, SPO.ORDER_ID, SPO.REMARK FROM STL_PAY_ORDERS SPO LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI ON SPO.MY_ACCT_NO = SCI.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI1 ON SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = SCI1.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON SPO.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE SPO.TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}

SELECT DISTINCT case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SPO.MY_ACCT_NO else SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO end payAcctNo, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO else SPO.MY_ACCT_NO end recAcctNo, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SCI.ACCT_NAME else SCI1.ACCT_NAME end payAcctName, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SCI1.ACCT_NAME else SCI.ACCT_NAME end recAcctName, SPO.PS, SPO.IS_NEED_SEND, SPO.PAY_TYPE, SPO.SETTLE_DATE, SPO.SETTLE_AMT, SPO.CCY, SPO.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, SPO.SETTLE_STATUS, SPO.PURPOSE, SPO.TRADE_ID, SPO.ORDER_ID, SPO.REMARK FROM WFL_STL_PAY_ORDERS SPO LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI ON SPO.MY_ACCT_NO = SCI.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI1 ON SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = SCI1.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON SPO.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE SPO.TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}
SELECT TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}
SELECT TRADE_ID FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}
SELECT COUNTER_TYPE FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY WHERE COUNTER_ID = #{counterId}
SELECT TRADE_MARKET FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_F01}
SELECT SEC_ACCT_SOURCE FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO WHERE SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId}
SELECT PAY_TYPE FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD WHERE FINPROD_ID=#{chlId}

SELECT B.TRD_ACCT_ID acctNo, C.ACCT_NAME acctName FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT A INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO B ON A.ACCT_NO = B.SEC_ACCT_ID inner join STL_CAPACCT_INFO C on B.TRD_ACCT_ID = C.ACCT_NO
AND A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}

SELECT DISTINCT case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SPO.MY_ACCT_NO else SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO end payAcctNo, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO else SPO.MY_ACCT_NO end recAcctNo, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SCI.ACCT_NAME else SCI1.ACCT_NAME end payAcctName, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SCI1.ACCT_NAME else SCI.ACCT_NAME end recAcctName, SPO.PS, SPO.IS_NEED_SEND, SPO.PAY_TYPE, SPO.SETTLE_DATE, SPO.SETTLE_AMT, SPO.CCY, SPO.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, SPO.SETTLE_STATUS, SPO.PURPOSE, SPO.TRADE_ID, SPO.ORDER_ID, SPO.REMARK FROM STL_PAY_ORDERS SPO LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI ON SPO.MY_ACCT_NO = SCI.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI1 ON SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = SCI1.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON SPO.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE SPO.TRADE_ID in (select tfpdt.trade_id from trd_product_deal tpd inner join trd_product_deal tfpdt on tpd.totle_trade_id = tfpdt.b_trade_id inner join pa_trd_product_deal ptpd on tfpdt.trade_id = ptpd.trade_id where tpd.trade_id = #{bizCode} and tfpdt.ps ='T11' ) ORDER BY SPO.ORDER_ID
